list.text: A battle would be fitting here.

lines: EndSpeech: Quem é você?nPorque está aqui?

list.text: I've been in this cave for ages now...
Did you come here looking for the Crystal Onix too?

lines: EndSpeech: É melhor sair de fininho...

list.text: I spent the whole day searching and it seems to have been in vain.
Have you ever seen a cave like this in your life?
I need to practice more with my Rock-type Pokémon.
If you came here looking for the legendary Crystal Onyx, you can leave right now!
I use Fire-type Pokémon to mold crystals and then sell them.
I don't know if you'lll be good enough to fight me.
Age is no reason to judge a Trainer...
\bVocê já achou algum cristal por aqui?

lines: EndSpeech: Estou procurando algo raro por aqui.

list.text: \bÉ melhor voltar para casa, por aqui não achei nada...
